description_en: Creates a custom cloud computer template
description_zh: 创建自定义的云电脑模板
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-bundle --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-4zfb6zj728hhr0000 --desktop-type eds.enterprise_office.2c4g --root-disk-size-gib 80 --user-disk-size-gib 70 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBundle

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The cloud computer specifications. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436974.html to query cloud computer templates and obtain the supported cloud computer specifications from the `DesktopType` parameter in the response.

Non-GPU images can only use non-GPU specifications, and GPU images can only use GPU specifications
parameters.help_zh:
云电脑规格。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436974.html查询云电脑模板，从返回的0参数获取当前支持的云电脑规格。

非GPU镜像只能选择非GPU规格，GPU镜像只能选择GPU规格
parameters.name: desktop_type

parameters.help_en: The system disk size. Unit: GiB. The supported system disk sizes correspond to the specifications. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188609.html
parameters.help_zh: 系统盘大小。单位：GiB。支持设置的系统盘大小与规格相对应。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188609.html
parameters.name: root_disk_size_gib

parameters.help_en: The name of the cloud computer template
parameters.name: bundle_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the cloud computer template
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The operating system language. Currently, only system images are supported. Valid values:

zh-CN: Simplified Chinese.
zh-HK: Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong (China)).
en-US: English.
ja-JP: Japanese
parameters.help_zh:
操作系统语言。目前只支持系统镜像。取值如下：

zh-CN：简体中文
zh-HK：繁体中文（香港）
en-US：英文
ja-JP：日文
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en: The list of data disk sizes. Currently, only one data disk can be configured
parameters.help_zh: 数据盘大小列表。目前只能设置一个数据盘
parameters.name: user_disk_size_gib

parameters.help_en: The performance level of the system cloud disk. When the cloud computer specifications are set to graphics or high frequency, you can configure the cloud disk performance level. For more information about the differences between performance levels, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html. Settings: standard SSD and ESSD cloud disks are supported
parameters.help_zh: 系统盘的性能等级。当云电脑规格设置为图形型或者高主频时，支持设置磁盘性能等级。关于各性能等级磁盘的差异，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.name: root_disk_performance_level

parameters.help_en: The performance level of the data cloud disk. When the cloud computer specifications are set to graphics or high frequency, you can configure the cloud disk performance level. For more information about the differences between performance levels, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html. Settings: standard SSD and ESSD cloud disks are supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据盘的性能等级。当云电脑规格设置为图形型或者高主频时，支持设置磁盘性能等级。关于各性能等级磁盘的差异，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.name: user_disk_performance_level
